Name: Android No Music Fix with SMAPI v3.7.6.9
Author: phalen
Description:
If you have a problem with your ANDROID game not playing music while modded with SMAPI, then the below solution will work for you.

How to fix the in-game music:

➜ Android ➜ OBB
Create a folder named "com.zane.stardewvalley"
Find and Open "com.chucklefish.stardewvalley" folder and copy the .obb file.
Paste the .obb file in "com.zane.stardewvalley"
DONE!

This info was pulled from [url=https://github.com/ZaneYork/SMAPI-Android-Installer/issues/54]https://github.com/ZaneYork/SMAPI-Android-Installer/issues/54[/url], first user to post the solution was "[url=https://github.com/Hurzhurzhurz]Hurzhurzhurz[/url]"
